title: RhizAeon: Fast, Accurate, Flexible and Scalable Recombination Analysis (Replication Package, Benchmark Datasets, and Source Code v0.1.1)
description: Complete replication package, empirical genomic alignments, simulation benchmark datasets (including the 1,000,000-trial Grand Continuous Parameter Sweep, the 3,200-trial Posada & Crandall 2001 coalescent benchmark, and 2,280 specialized epidemiological/evolutionary benchmark alignments), figure reproduction scripts, WebAssembly application, and Rust source code (v0.1.1) for the manuscript: RhizAeon: Fast, Accurate, Flexible and Scalable Recombination Analysis.
